## Description

Constructs persistence landscapes from 0-dimensional Betti connected components in sliding asset correlation metric spaces, trading relative value mispricings when landscape cluster norms deviate.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage across multi-asset classes, relative value mispricing detection during regime shifts.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Desks, Quantitative Multi-Asset Funds.

## Required data

Multivariate rolling distance matrices, asset return series, liquidity filters.

## Caveats

Persistence landscape vector norm calculations require efficient vectorization for real-time tracking.
